保存后再继续，或放弃本次编辑。: Save before continuing, or discard these edits.

按回车打开当前路径: Press Enter to open this path

Enter记下 · Esc取消 · 不用填写日期。: Enter to save · Esc to cancel · No date required.
先做一件，或给自己多一点时间。: Take one step, or give yourself a little more time.

内置模块保留功能名称；仅提供适用的图标、路径和开关配置。: Built-in modules keep their names. Available icons, paths and switches can be configured.
仅修改这一次，提醒同步移动。: Change this occurrence only; the reminder moves with it.
调整左侧参数，右侧即时预览；保存后应用到桌面。: Adjust options on the left and preview on the right. Save to apply.
先看清哪些能力和后台活动会变化。: Review changes to capabilities and background activity first.
模板可混搭：先切换，再在设置里微调，另存为自己的方案。: Start with a template, adjust Settings, then save your own profile.
双击改标题 · 拖到左侧日历改期: Double-click to edit · Drag to the calendar to reschedule
常规与快捷键统一保存，立即生效。: General settings and hotkeys save together and apply immediately.
功能开关与停靠设置保存后立即生效。: Module switches and docking settings apply after saving.

限额单独保存；本地操作不占用模型请求额度。: Limits save separately. Local actions do not use model requests.
新建或编辑组合后保存；执行时不调用模型 API。: Save after editing routines. Running them does not call a model API.
API 单独保存；Key 只在本机加密存储。: API settings save separately. Keys are encrypted locally.

示例模式 · 不修改启动项，不启动外部软件，不联网。: Preview · No startup changes, external apps or network access.
从邮箱入口选择现有客户端；Leo不读取账户和邮件。: Choose your existing client from Mail. Leo does not read accounts or messages.
依赖检查通过；不代表外部软件已启动。: Dependencies found. This does not mean the external app is running.
依赖状态尚未确认或仅部分可用；未进行启动、联网或运行验证。: Dependencies are unconfirmed or partly available. No launch, network or runtime check was performed.

只修改方案名称，不修改伙伴名字。: Only the profile name changes, not your pet's name.

契约归属不一致，未采用该检测结果。: Contract ownership mismatch; the check result was ignored.
契约或被动依赖状态无法读取；未执行扩展，可在原扩展管理中检查。: Cannot read contract or passive dependency state. The extension was not run; check its manager.
存在无法读取的扩展声明；请在原扩展管理中检查。: An extension declaration cannot be read. Check the extension manager.
已放弃后续计划；已提交的操作不会撤销。: Remaining steps discarded. Submitted actions are not undone.
已返回，刚才的执行结果保留。: Returned. Previous execution results are kept.
应用标识重复，请在原应用配置中处理。: Duplicate app identity. Resolve it in App settings.
当前契约未连接，请重新打开设置检查。: Current contract is not connected. Reopen Settings to check.
当前能力不可用；入口显示设置不等同于模块启停。: Capability unavailable. Entry visibility does not enable or disable modules.
扩展已停用；可在原扩展管理中启用。: Extension disabled. Enable it in the extension manager.
指定的软件路径已失效或不匹配。: The specified app path is invalid or does not match.
指定的软件路径无法使用。: The specified app path is unavailable.
方案切换失败，恢复原配置也未完成，请重新打开设置检查。: Profile switch and rollback did not complete. Reopen Settings to check.
方案文件无法读取，原文件保留；请修复或备份后再管理方案。: Cannot read profiles. Original file kept; repair or back it up before continuing.
未启用或被 Windows 停用: Not enabled, or disabled by Windows
未找到本地软件；安装后重新检查，或指定便携版。: Local app not found. Install and recheck, or choose a portable app.
未连接当前契约，或配置草稿与运行配置不同；未执行检测。: Current contract not connected, or draft differs from running settings. No check performed.
模板不可覆盖，请先另存为自定义方案。: Templates cannot be overwritten. Save a custom profile first.
模板保留原名，请另存为自定义方案。: Templates keep their original names. Save a custom profile instead.
正在执行操作，等待软件或接口就绪…: Running action; waiting for the app or interface…
此应用已在模块列表中，可到设置编辑。: This app is already in the module list. Edit it in Settings.
移除此自定义皮肤？原始导入图片不会删除。: Remove this custom skin? Original imported images will not be deleted.
能力已停用；原显示位置及启动配置保留。: Capability disabled. Original entry location and launch settings are kept.
计划已完成；应用启动只确认请求已提交。: Plan complete. App launches are confirmed only as submitted.
运行配置已变化，请保存设置后重新检查。: Running settings changed. Save and check again.
